utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club’s been lively lately — Mara, Jun, and Peter are usually there, and Lina dropped by last week too. We’re reading "The Lantern House" next, so I’m bracing for opinions already!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, nice — thanks for the update. What time are we meeting for it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check on the time and pass it along — probably the usual spot, but I want to make sure before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the location and time when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the location and confirm Thursday at 7:30 once I’ve checked with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll watch for your text and see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — how’s the book club going these days?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we actually set on the time and place, or is that still being debated?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Ha, sounds like it’s still being hashed out a bit — what’s the latest everyone’s leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday evenings could work after pickup. What book are they leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m not sure yet—can you send me the book title when you know?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure—send me the title when you have it, and I’ll keep an eye out after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send the next meeting time and the book list right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you also confirm the exact address and whether we’re still meeting at Quinn’s place on Maple Street?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the exact address and whether it’s still at Quinn’s place on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, Thursday evening is still the plan — we’ll keep it simple and chat about the first half of the book. I may mix up the title again, but I’m pretty sure on the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll repeat Thursday evening and the first half of the book to the group so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. If I forget the title again, at least we’ve got Thursday evening straight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll still come by late with the tea and biscuits, and just let me know if the plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works fine, Dane — just come by when you can, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll swing by late with the tea and biscuits, then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure yet, Nell, but I can ask around and find out for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate that. I’ve been hearing just enough to be curious, so let me know what you find out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll ask around and let you know what I find out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the book club details before I say for certain.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries — I’m probably the wrong person to trust with details anyway. Just let me know once you check, and I’ll try not to miss it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll check the details and get back to you once I’ve confirmed the book and time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — we’re still meeting at the library on Thursday, and I’ll bring the tea and biscuits.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, Cleo — thank you! I’ll spread the word and make sure everyone knows Thursday at 7 in the community room by the library.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thank you, Quinn — I’ll have the tea and biscuits ready for Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s wonderful—thanks, Opal. I’ll let the group know, and I’m excited to see everyone Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Glad to help — I’ve got the community center and Thursday at 7 PM noted. Looking forward to it!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect, thanks, Opal — I’ll share the details with everyone and see you Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’m probably going to sit this one out, but I hope the book club goes well.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Uli — thanks for letting me know, and I’ll keep you posted in case you want to join another time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I appreciate it — maybe next time when things are calmer.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at 7 at your place on Maple Street still works for me — I just want to make sure that’s the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks for checking — I still don’t want to guess since I don’t have the details confirmed. Let’s verify with the group chat before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s sensible — I’d rather confirm the time and place in the group chat before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Have you all settled on the book for this month yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet, but I’ll bring it up with the group again so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Let me know what the group decides when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the book club details first so I don’t mix anything up. Once I confirm the book and time, I’ll let everyone know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks, Hana. Once you’ve got the book and time, I’ll help spread the word to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll verify the book and time, then send the update so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? Mara, Jun, and Peter are the regulars, and Lina popped in last week — and next up is "The Lantern House."

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the time and where you’re meeting, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’re meeting at the community center next Thursday at 7 PM — hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus—can you ask around and let me know what book we’re reading next?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina—I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear what book we’re reading next.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. And are we still meeting at the library on Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — just to keep you in the loop, the book club moved to Thursday at the cafe, and I’ll send the title and time later today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — the book club is now Thursday at the cafe. I’ll keep that noted and wait for the title and time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it, and I’ll send the book title and time later today so everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — I’m probably going to sit this one out, but I hope it goes well.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries, Uli — maybe next time. I’ll probably forget half the details anyway, so it’s nice having everyone keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ha, that sounds about right — hope it’s a good one anyway. Maybe next time, if things are calmer for me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Ira — you should come to book club this Thursday at 7 in the community room by the library, and I’ll save you a seat!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks — I’ll plan on 7 Thursday at the community room by the library.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful — see you Thursday at 7 in the community room by the library! I’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, Thursday at 7 at the community center — first half of the book, nice and easy. I’ll probably still forget the title, but I’ve got the plan!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — I’ve got the title and book list covered, and I’ll remind you if you want. See you Thursday at 7 at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, Sam — thanks for keeping me straight. See you Thursday at 7 at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — we’re still meeting at the library on Thursday, and I’ll bring the tea and biscuits.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday works for me as long as it’s after pickup—thanks for bringing tea and biscuits. What book are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re reading *The Midnight Library* this month—if you’d like, I can lend you my copy.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the time and place for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 7 on Thursday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — so Thursday at 7 at the community center, right?
